definitions.N: normalized root input_size_units fixed for the whole run
definitions.S: a nonterminal canonical residual reachable under the fixed deterministic theorem-mode algorithm
definitions.R: the set of currently live original root variables
definitions.G_elim(S): canonical live-pivot list tested by first_capped_elimination
definitions.G_v2(S): all nondegenerate sign-aware literal pairs co-occurring in S, enumerated in frozen canonical order by v2
definitions.SAFE_elim(S,x): exact eliminate_var_capped(S,x,N^2) returns a CNF and exact replay verifies it
definitions.SAFE_v2(S,a,b): the frozen exact B2 pair macro for (a,b), followed atomically by a roots_only exact capped elimination, is admitted and strictly decreases frozen progress phi

already_proved_polynomial_grammar_size.v2_pair_types: |G_v2(S)| <= 4*binom(n,2) = 2*n*(n-1) = O(N^2), because retained live-variable count never exceeds the original n<=N
already_proved_polynomial_grammar_size.consequence: The root-phase candidate grammar itself is polynomial-size. The missing theorem is availability/totality, not enumeration size.

main_candidate.statement: For every reachable nonterminal root-phase state S of the fixed algorithm after the exact terminal portfolio has declined to decide, either there exists x in G_elim(S) with SAFE_elim(S,x), or there exists (a,b) in G_v2(S) with SAFE_v2(S,a,b).
main_candidate.equivalent_failure_witness: A reachable root-phase state at the ordinary-elimination call site for which every canonical ordinary pivot overflows the fixed N^2 raw cap and frozen exhaustive v2 returns no exact strict-progress root rescue.

L1A_ALL_PIVOT_OVERFLOW_FORCES_FREQUENT_P.statement: Every reachable root-phase state S with all ordinary pivots overflowing N^2 has max sign-aware literal-pair cooccurrence t_max >= s-2N+11.

L1B_ALL_PIVOT_OVERFLOW_FORCES_PAIR_DENSI.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-pivot-overflow state satisfies P >= 2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), where P=sum_C binom(|C|,2).

current_structural_subcandidate.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-ordinary-overflow state contains some co-occurring pair (a,b), where a is a signed literal of a live original root variable x, such that B_drain(a,b)=s-t+10+(n+1)*(c_sigma-t+1)*(c_opp+1) <= N^2.
current_structural_subcandidate.why_useful: The proved B2_POLARITY_DRAINAGE_SUFFICIENT_ROOT_RESCUE lemma makes such a pair sufficient for an exact frozen v2 root rescue; therefore L1C would imply L1 in the all-ordinary-overflow region.

known_reductions.low_volume: If s<=N, every live pivot fits N^2; therefore L1 is automatic there.
known_reductions.frequent_pair: If t_max>=s-2N+11, frozen v2 rescue is guaranteed, but M80 proves this condition is not necessary.
known_reductions.pair_density: If P>=2*n*(n-1)*(s-2N+11), v2 rescue is guaranteed, but M80 proves this condition is not necessary.
known_reductions.polarity_drainage: If any live-root literal pair satisfies B_drain<=N^2, frozen v2 root rescue is guaranteed even when the macro remains high-volume.
known_reductions.unresolved_region: roots live AND all ordinary pivots overflow N^2 AND no currently proved sufficient v2 rescue condition is known to trigger.

falsification_protocol.rule: A state that is not reachable under the fixed deterministic theorem core cannot refute L1 or L1C.
procedure: Generate hostile canonical root CNFs without using SAT truth labels in selection.
Replay the frozen theorem-mode prefix exactly and freeze only certified reachable root-phase states.
At every state where every ordinary pivot overflows, enumerate all co-occurring sign-aware pairs exactly.
Evaluate B_drain for every pair whose first literal or second literal belongs to a live original root variable, considering the actual sign used by the pair.
Run the unmodified frozen v2 discovery on the same state.
If v2 returns None, freeze the source CNF, state CNF, exact event prefix and candidate measurements as an L1 counterexample.
If no pair satisfies B_drain<=N^2 but v2 succeeds, refute L1C and inspect the exact successful v2 mechanism to derive a weaker candidate.
Absence of a bounded counterexample never promotes L1 or L1C to a theorem.

proof_obligations_if_L1_survives: Give a symbolic existence proof for at least one exact ordinary or v2 grammar move on every reachable root-phase state.
Show deterministic discovery and exact verification work remain polynomial in original N, including failed grammar candidates.
Compose L1 with the proved conditional root-phase grammar composition lemma and the PIRC input-relative envelope bridge.
Separately close the root-free v3 tail; L1 alone is insufficient for universal P2 preservation.
